subject: MAP: Prompt pack & test-case consignment — logistics, retention, usage covenants
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Shaw <laura.shaw@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Patrick Murray <patrick.murray@clearsight.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Prompt pack & test-case consignment — logistics, retention, usage covenants

Hi Laura / Patrick,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great alignment on scope. As discussed, I'm attaching an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a first-cut consignment of assets (prompt pack + a small sample of test cases) so your evaluation team can run the acceptance tests we outlined.

High-level asks from our side:
- Redwood provides: prompt pack v1 (zipped), 200 representative test cases (CSV sample attached), a short-run server-side scoring harness for local smoke tests.
- ClearSight provides: a point of contact for data ingestion, signed MAP, and confirmation of secure ephemeral storage for the assets.
- Usage covenant: assets are for evaluation only, not to be redistributed, and will be deleted within 90 days of receipt unless otherwise agreed.

Please find: MAP_Clearsight_v1.pdf (high-level milestones + ownership), clearsight_promptpack_v1.zip (prompts, annotations), testcases_sample.csv. I also included a DocuSign link in the MAP for signature.

Proposed timeline:
1) 5/19 — Your security review of the consignment (point P1)
2) 5/21 — Sign MAP and issue access token for the sandbox
3) 5/21–6/04 — Evaluation window (two weeks)
4) 6/05 — De-brief + rollback/retention decision

Can you confirm the two things we discussed on the call: (1) you can accept the sample CSV format (first column = prompt_id, second = prompt_text, third = expected_behavior_comments), and (2) you have a secure S3 bucket or VPC path we can push to once the MAP is signed?

If that looks good, we'll: (a) push the full prompt pack to the secure path after signature, (b) enable the scoring harness, and (c) configure the MAP milestones in our pipeline so both teams get reminders.

Thanks — Soojin

---
Attachments: MAP_Clearsight_v1.pdf (doc), clearsight_promptpack_v1.zip (archive), testcases_sample.csv (csv)

From: Laura Shaw <laura.shaw@clearsight.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Prompt pack & test-case consignment — logistics, retention, usage covenants

Soojin,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear plan. A few notes from our security and legal:
- The CSV schema is fine. We will validate on ingest and flag any rows with PII.
- Retention window: security is asking for a 60-day default retention for the prompt pack artifacts in our sandbox (rather than 90). Can we agree to 60 days with the option to extend to 90 by mutual written consent?
- NDAs: legal wants a brief addendum limiting internal access to the evaluation team and forbidding downstream export. We'll attach their proposed language if that's acceptable.

On infrastructure: we have a locked evaluation S3 prefix in our AWS account (s3://clearsight-eval/redwood/DEAL-4721/) — we can provision a short-lived STS role for Redwood service account access after MAP signature.

I reviewed the MAP and added a couple of inline comments (DocuSign link). If you can accept the 60-day default retention and sign the addendum, we can move to sign on 5/21 and start the ingestion.

Best,
Laura

---
Attachments referenced: legal_addendum_CSA.pdf (pending)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP: Prompt pack & test-case consignment — logistics, retention, usage covenants

Team — FYI / quick action request.

We received counterpoints from ClearSight (see thread below):
- They want default 60-day retention vs our proposed 90.
- Legal will ask for an internal-access restriction addendum.
- They have a secure s3 path and will grant STS access post-signature.

Can you please weigh in on the two quick items:
1) Is 60 days acceptable from our risk/analytics perspective (Marissa)? Any technical constraints if they later ask to extend?
2) Karthik — can you review the legal addendum language for any blocking IP/usability clauses?

If both are ok, I'll accept the 60-day window with an explicit extension clause (written consent) and push the MAP to DocuSign on 5/21.

Thanks — Soojin

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP: Prompt pack & test-case consignment — logistics, retention, usage covenants

Soojin — 60 days is acceptable from our side for the evaluation assets as long as we have two things:
1) A checklist confirming secure deletion (logs + deletion manifest) when they request purge at day 60 (redwood to verify), and
2) A fallback retention procedure if they request an extension (we should require documented approval and update the MAP runbook).

Note: scoring harness will need to be run in their environment; if they want us to run it on-host, we must ensure the STS role only allows PutObject/GetObject to that prefix and no cross-account snapshots. I can add the access checklist to the MAP.

-Marissa

---
Attachment: access_checklist_v1.md

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP: Prompt pack & test-case consignment — logistics, retention, usage covenants

Soojin — I reviewed the proposed legal addendum. High-level:
- Redlines: we should replace any broad "derivative works" language with a narrow "evaluation-only output" clause. We cannot accept language that could be interpreted as assigning model improvements back to ClearSight.
- IP carveouts: add an explicit statement that Redwood retains pre-existing model/tooling IP and any server-side scoring code we ship under evaluation license.
- Approve the 60-day retention if they accept the extension-by-written-consent language.

I'll send tracked changes (inline) to Laura's counsel and copy you.

-Karthik

---
Attachment: legal_redlines_CSA_v1.docx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Shaw <laura.shaw@clearsight.ai>, Patrick Murray <patrick.murray@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Prompt pack & test-case consignment — logistics, retention, usage covenants

Laura / Patrick — thank you for the quick review and for providing the S3 prefix. We're aligned on the following final points:
- Retention: Accept 60-day default with explicit extension to 90 days only by mutual written consent (MAP Addendum clause 3.2).
- Access: We'll accept STS temporary role to s3://clearsight-eval/redwood/DEAL-4721/ with strict Put/Get/Delete limited to that prefix. Marissa to validate checklist during provisioning.
- Legal: Karthik has provided redlines to the addendum; please review the tracked changes. Key asks: evaluation-only outputs, Redwood retains pre-existing IP & scoring harness rights.

Next steps:
- 5/21 EOD: sign MAP (DocuSign).
- 5/22: Redwood will push full prompt pack to your S3 prefix and enable scoring harness access.
- 5/22–6/04: evaluation window; Redwood will run daily token-usage metering reports and a mid-point quality check on 5/29.

If we see no blocking issues, we'll proceed to DocuSign on 5/21. Please confirm by 5/21 12:00 PT if you need any final change.

Best,
Soojin

---
Attachments: MAP_Clearsight_v1_signed_stub.pdf (pending), clearsight_promptpack_v1.zip (archive)

Subject: Re: MAP: Prompt pack & test-case consignment — logistics, retention, usage covenants

Soojin — all good from our side. We'll sign the MAP on 5/21, and I've asked infra to prepare the STS role for a 7-day token window.

Also attaching the legal addendum with our requested edits (minor). We'll confirm by noon tomorrow. Looking forward to the mid-point check.

Regards,
Patrick
